At the Security Council's 9786th meeting (18 Nov 2024), draft S/2024/826 (Sierra Leone/UK) proposed ending Sudan hostilities, protecting civilians, and facilitating humanitarian access. No other delegation explicitly qualified the draft's specific measures in the record.

The recorded vote was 14–1. The draft's proposed measures were not adopted.
